notes: One scheme across the brand: Domera OS cameras (DDF6050DN, RDF5000DN/RDF6000DN Domera, SDF6800DN/SDF6900DN, DDZ5230DN/DDZ5530DN/DDZ5000DN-IR and the Panomera MK2 / Perimeter / Skyview / V8 multifocal systems), the legacy 5000 series (DF/DDF/MDF/SDF 5xxx HD) and the legacy 4000/5000 PTZ firmware (DDZ52xxHD, DDZ5x36HD-DN-IR) all serve rtsp://<ip>:554/encoder<N>. Domera OS documents streams 1-3 (stream 1 is always enabled; streams 2 and 3 must be enabled first), the 5000 series firmware documents encoders 1-4 (/encoder4 as well), and the legacy PTZ firmware documents encoders 1-2 only. The codec is whatever is configured for that encoder in the web interface. The RTSP server must be enabled under Network Services, and either a user holding the RTSP live access right is used or "Allow RTSP access without credentials" is selected. A changed RTSP port must be written into the URL.
